method: Fresh copied initial-data per firmware session; Run source then scripted device keys/touch; returned MSGBOX text visually transcribed. No physical calculator access.

cases.name: cancel
cases.source: EXPORT ZZT_NATIVE_EDITMAT() BEGIN M1:=[[1,2],[3,4]]; LOCAL a:=EDITMAT(M1); MSGBOX(STRING({M1,a})); END;

cases.name: global-ok
cases.source: EXPORT ZZT_NATIVE_EDITMAT() BEGIN M1:=[[1,2],[3,4]]; LOCAL a:=EDITMAT(M1); MSGBOX(STRING({M1,a})); END;

cases.name: local-ok
cases.source: EXPORT ZZT_NATIVE_EDITMAT() BEGIN LOCAL a:=[[1,2],[3,4]]; LOCAL b:=EDITMAT(a); MSGBOX(STRING({a,b})); END;

cases.name: expression-ok
cases.source: EXPORT ZZT_NATIVE_EDITMAT() BEGIN LOCAL b:=EDITMAT([[1,2],[3,4]]); MSGBOX(STRING(b)); END;

cases.name: readonly
cases.source: EXPORT ZZT_NATIVE_EDITMAT() BEGIN M1:=[[1,2],[3,4]]; LOCAL a:=EDITMAT(M1,{"View",{"Row A","Row B"},{"X","Y"}},1); MSGBOX(STRING({M1,a})); END;
